papers.title: The health benefits of alkaline water: is it a fact or marketing myth?
papers.authors: Alebrahim H, Alsaei A, Sefen P, Hasan M, Ramadhan A, Deen G
papers.abstract: Alkaline water has gained widespread popularity and is frequently marketed for benefits related to hydration, acid-base balance, metabolic health, and immune function. These claims are increasingly encountered in primary care, yet their clinical validity remains uncertain. To critically evaluate current evidence on alkaline water, focusing on its physiological effects, clinical relevance, and safety in routine patient care. A narrative review of the literature was conducted, including human clinical studies, experimental interventions, and animal models. Outcomes examined included gastrointestinal health, hydration status, bone metabolism, metabolic parameters, oxidative stress, and immune function. Evidence suggests that alkaline water provides limited, context-specific benefits. The most consistent findings relate to gastrointestinal effects, particularly pepsin inactivation and potential improvement in reflux-related symptoms. Modest effects on hydration markers, urinary pH, and selected indicators of bone resorption have been reported, especially with bicarbonate-rich formulations. In contrast, evidence supporting metabolic, antioxidant, and immunological benefits is inconsistent and largely derived from small or preclinical studies. Claims of systemic alkalinization, enhanced immunity, anti-aging, and disease prevention are not supported by robust clinical evidence. Alkaline water should not be routinely recommended in primary care. Clinicians should emphasize evidence-based interventions and exercise caution in vulnerable populations, including individuals with chronic kidney disease, those on acid-suppressive therapy, pregnant women, and children. Alkaline water has limited clinical utility. Its effects are modest and likely driven more by mineral composition than pH alone. Further well-designed, long-term studies are required before definitive recommendations can be made.
papers.noteTitle: 鹼性水的健康效益：事實或行銷迷思的品質評讀
papers.content:
# The health benefits of alkaline water: is it a fact or marketing myth?

> [!info] 品質快照
> **設計**：narrative review｜**全文**：已讀取 Frontiers 官方 OA PDF，19 頁｜**RoB**：SANRA 取向，整體中等偏高疑慮｜**GRADE**：未適用單一合併 outcome，證據以小型人體研究、體外研究與動物研究混合｜**一句話判斷**：文章把「局部或配方相關效果」與「全身鹼化、抗老、增強免疫」分開，結論大致保守，但搜尋方法、納入流程與量化整合不足，不能當作臨床指引。

## 白話導讀

> [!abstract]
> - **這篇在說什麼**：鹼性水的效果可能來自 bicarbonate、calcium、magnesium 或 dissolved hydrogen 等配方成分，單看 pH 不夠。
> - **為什麼要看**：市面宣稱常把尿液 pH、體外 pepsin 失活或動物結果，延伸成全身鹼化、抗癌或增強免疫。
> - **主要發現**：pH 8.8 鹼性水在體外可讓 pepsin 失活，部分礦泉水研究出現水分、尿液 pH 或骨吸收替代指標的小幅變化，人體代謝與免疫結果不一致。
> - **實務判斷**：一般成人不需例行改喝鹼性水。慢性腎病、心衰竭、限鈉或限液、使用 PPI、兒童與孕婦要先評估礦物質與飲水量。

## 研究問題與方法

作者以敘述性文獻回顧整理鹼性水的定義、製程、腸胃、補水、骨代謝、代謝、免疫與安全性。全文納入人體臨床研究、實驗介入、體外研究與動物模型。文章未提供可重現的資料庫清單、完整搜尋式、日期範圍、篩選人數流程或預先註冊，因此屬概念整理，不能視為 systematic review 或 meta-analysis。

## 主要發現

| 主題 | 全文依據 | 解讀 |
|---|---|---|
| 酸鹼恆定 | 健康成人血液 pH 約 7.35–7.45，由肺、腎與緩衝系統調節 | 尿液 pH 改變不等於血液被鹼化 |
| Pepsin | pH 8.8 鹼性水在體外使 pepsin 3b 失活，合成胜肽水解速率約為自來水的 1/5 | 是局部、體外機制，不能直接等同 GERD 症狀改善 |
| 補水與運動 | 少數運動研究報告水分保留或血液黏度替代指標改善 | 研究條件與產品配方差異大，臨床效益仍有限 |
| 骨代謝 | 富含 calcium 或 bicarbonate 的礦泉水，部分研究降低尿鈣或骨吸收指標 | 不能推論骨密度增加或骨折下降 |
| 血糖、血脂與免疫 | 人體結果分歧，部分效果來自含氫或礦物質配方，動物結果較明顯 | 動物與體外結果不能直接外推成人臨床 |
| 腎臟與電解質 | 高 sodium、potassium、magnesium 或 bicarbonate 會增加腎溶質負荷，病例報告涉及 calcium-alkali syndrome | CKD、心衰竭、限鈉或限液者須個別評估 |

## 臨床評讀

### 研究設計與偏差

- **研究問題清楚度**：有清楚的臨床問題與安全性焦點。
- **搜尋透明度**：未看到完整資料庫、搜尋式、排除數量與研究品質評分，重現性不足。
- **證據混合**：人體、體外、動物與病例報告並列，若讀者未分層，容易高估證據。
- **結果整合**：沒有 effect size、信賴區間或異質性統計，無法估計平均效益。
- **選擇性報告疑慮**：文章多次提醒結果不一致，但未提供完整納入研究表，仍需留意引用取捨。

### 推論漏洞

1. 體外 pepsin 失活不能直接推論所有 reflux 患者症狀改善。
2. 尿液 pH 或氧化壓力替代指標不能代替血液 pH、骨折、住院或死亡等臨床結果。
3. 動物模型的 LDL、總膽固醇、肝脂肪或 HOMA-IR 變化不能直接套用成人治療。
4. 產品同時改變 pH、礦物質、ORP 與 dissolved hydrogen，若沒有等礦物質對照組，無法判斷作用來源。

### GRADE 與實務結論

本篇是 narrative review，沒有單一 PICO outcome 可直接計算一個總 GRADE。依證據來源分層判斷：體外 pepsin 機制為極低確定性，人體補水、骨代謝與代謝指標為低至極低確定性，常規預防疾病或全身鹼化的主張沒有足夠臨床證據。

一般成人可把鹼性水當作飲水選項，不能取代 GERD 治療、飲食調整、藥物或慢性病管理。選購時應看 sodium、calcium、magnesium、potassium 與 bicarbonate，而非只看 pH。CKD、心衰竭、限鈉、限液、使用 PPI、兒童、孕婦與高齡者，需把產品礦物質與總飲水量納入評估。

## 需要補強的研究

未來研究應預先註冊、清楚區分 pH 與礦物質配方、使用適當中性水對照、報告長期臨床 outcome，並針對 CKD、心衰竭、兒童與高齡族群做安全性監測。若要宣稱 reflux 效益，應以症狀量表、內視鏡或治療需求作為主要 outcome，而非只用體外 pepsin 或尿液 pH。

## Reference

Alebrahim H, Alsaei A, Sefen P, Hasan M, Ramadhan A, Deen GR. 2026. *Frontiers in Medicine*. DOI: 10.3389/fmed.2026.1849818. Full text: Frontiers official open-access PDF, 19 pages.

papers.title: Non-advanced age-related macular degeneration: Current concepts and future perspectives.
papers.authors: Cozzi M, Zweifel S, Spooner K, Romano F, Guymer R, Sadda S, Staurenghi G, Invernizzi A
papers.abstract: Non-advanced age-related macular degeneration (AMD), encompassing early and intermediate stages, represents a critical therapeutic window before irreversible central vision loss. Traditionally defined by drusen size and pigmentary abnormalities on color fundus photography, disease characterization has evolved substantially with the integration of multimodal imaging biomarkers. Contemporary imaging enables detailed structural phenotyping, including reticular pseudodrusen (also known as subretinal drusenoid deposits), hyperreflective foci, and incomplete retinal pigment epithelium and outer retinal atrophy, which refine risk stratification and provide insight into progression toward advanced disease. Functional assessment has expanded beyond best-corrected visual acuity to include low-luminance visual acuity, contrast sensitivity, dark adaptation, and microperimetry, many of which are more sensitive to early dysfunction. However, standardization and regulatory approval of these endpoints remain ongoing challenges. Non-advanced AMD arises from complex interactions among genetic susceptibility, aging, environmental exposures, and systemic metabolic factors. Smoking remains the strongest modifiable risk factor, while Mediterranean dietary patterns appear protective. Currently, no pharmacologic therapies are approved for non-advanced AMD. The Age-Related Eye Disease Study formulations remain the only interventions proven to reduce progression in high-risk individuals. Emerging approaches, including subthreshold laser therapy and photobiomodulation, show preliminary promise but require validation in robust and adequately powered randomized clinical trials. Recent consensus efforts emphasize biomarker-driven classification and highlight the heterogeneity of AMD phenotypes across populations. Future research priorities include validation of quantitative imaging and functional endpoints, integration of artificial intelligence-based predictive models, and development of targeted therapies to delay progression. These endevours will be essential to advance precision prevention strategies.

> [!warning] 全文限制
> 本次只取得 queue 摘要，出版社 PDF 受到存取限制。Methods、完整 references、圖表與研究選擇流程仍需全文確認。

> [!info] 品質快照
> 設計：narrative review，聚焦 early 與 intermediate AMD
> RoB：摘要不足以使用 SANRA 完整評分，研究選擇與引用平衡待全文核對
> GRADE：n.a.，本文為敘述性回顧
> 一句話 verdict：內容適合做早期 AMD 導讀，但 AREDS、飲食、影像 biomarker 與新興治療的證據層級需要回到全文及原始試驗逐項核對。

## Summary

> Abstract-level review only。本文沒有把摘要外的細節補成確定結論。

- 非進展期 AMD 包含 early 與 intermediate stages，是延緩 central vision loss 的介入窗口。
- multimodal imaging 納入 reticular pseudodrusen、hyperreflective foci、iRORA 等結構 biomarker，可改善風險分層。
- 功能評估從 BCVA 擴展到 low-luminance visual acuity、contrast sensitivity、dark adaptation 與 microperimetry。
- smoking 是重要可改變風險因子，Mediterranean dietary pattern 可能具保護關聯。
- 尚無核准的非進展期 AMD 藥物。AREDS formulations 對高風險個案仍是已有進展預防證據的主要介入，subthreshold laser 與 photobiomodulation 尚待大型 RCT。

## 白話導讀

> [!abstract] 整篇講給你聽
> AMD 還沒有進展到嚴重視力損失以前，醫師可以用更細的影像與功能檢查找出高風險變化。生活面最有把握的方向是戒菸、維持健康飲食，並依適用族群評估 AREDS 配方。新型雷射與光生物調節有研究希望，還不能當成常規治療。

## Paper Details

### 目前可用的評估

- 結構：drusen、pigmentary abnormality、reticular pseudodrusen、hyperreflective foci、iRORA。
- 功能：BCVA、low-luminance visual acuity、contrast sensitivity、dark adaptation、microperimetry。
- 限制：許多 endpoint 尚未完成標準化或 regulatory approval，跨研究比較仍受限。

### 臨床應用

- 戒菸應列入每次 AMD 風險溝通。
- Mediterranean dietary pattern 可作為健康飲食方向，摘要呈現的是關聯訊號，不能直接解讀為治療效果。
- AREDS formulations 的適用性要依 AMD stage、雙眼風險、吸菸狀態與眼科醫師判斷。
- subthreshold laser 與 photobiomodulation 仍屬研究性介入。
- AI prediction model 與 quantitative imaging 需要先確認外部驗證與族群適用性。

## Critical Appraisal

- **優點**：涵蓋影像、功能、遺傳、環境及新興治療，臨床問題聚焦在早期風險分層。
- **主要偏差風險**：摘要沒有交代搜尋策略、納入排除、引用平衡、研究品質工具或利益衝突細節，無法完成 SANRA 與引用選擇核對。
- **推論漏洞**：Mediterranean diet 的保護訊號可能來自觀察性研究，不能直接當成 AMD 進展的因果預防效果。AREDS 的適用族群也不能由高風險個案直接外推到所有 non-advanced AMD。
- **全文待核對**：AREDS 原始試驗、subthreshold laser、photobiomodulation 的試驗設計與 endpoint，及影像 biomarker 對實際進展預測的 calibration。

## Reference

- Cozzi M, Zweifel S, Spooner K, et al. Non-advanced age-related macular degeneration: current concepts and future perspectives. Asia-Pacific Journal of Ophthalmology. 2026. DOI: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.apjo.2026.100346

papers.title: Association between diabetes and elevated circulating advanced oxidation protein products: a comprehensive systematic review and meta-analysis.
papers.authors: Iqbal M, Khan M, Farooqui S, Zahid Iqbal M, Khan S, Khan N, Seshadri V, Abdelgawwad El-Sehrawy A
papers.abstract: Oxidative stress is a central feature of the metabolic disturbances observed in diabetes, often leading to cellular and molecular damage. Advanced oxidation protein products (AOPPs), formed during oxidative modification of plasma proteins, have been proposed as biomarkers of systemic oxidative stress. Despite increasing interest, the relationship between these markers and diabetes remains inconclusive. This study aimed to systematically evaluate and quantify differences in circulating AOPPs levels in diabetes. A systematic review and meta-analysis was performed in accordance with PRISMA guidelines. Searches were conducted across PubMed, Scopus, Embase and Web of Science databases up to March 2025 to identify relevant observational studies involving adults aged 18 years or older. Studies were included if they reported circulating levels of AOPPs in individuals with type 1 diabetes (T1DM), type 2 diabetes (T2DM), or impaired fasting glucose (IFG) or impaired glucose tolerance (IGT), compared to non-diabetic controls. Data extraction and quality assessment were conducted independently by two reviewers, and a random-effects model was used for meta-analysis. Sixteen eligible articles with twenty individual studies were identified, encompassing diverse populations and diabetes subtypes. The meta-analysis demonstrated significantly elevated circulating AOPPs in both T1DM (WMD ≈ 17.5 µmol/L) and T2DM (WMD ≈ 24.68 µmol/L) compared with controls, though heterogeneity was high. Subgroup analyses confirmed the consistent direction of effect, with stronger associations in younger populations, studies with higher baseline AOPPs, and certain designs or regions. Meta-regression showed that examined moderators (continent, study design, baseline AOPPs, age, sample size, gender, study quality, presence of overweight/ obesity, hypertension, smoking and abnormal serum lipids) explained little to none of the variability. Sensitivity analyses indicated that results were robust. Publication bias assessment revealed funnel plot asymmetry for type 2 diabetes, but trim-and-fill analysis did not materially alter the pooled estimates, supporting the stability of the findings. Elevated levels of AOPPs appear to be associated with diabetes, supporting the role of oxidative stress in its pathophysiology. Although pooled analyses demonstrated significantly higher circulating AOPP concentrations in patients with diabetes mellitus, substantial between-study heterogeneity and wide prediction intervals suggest that the magnitude and consistency of this association may vary across different populations and study settings. Also, the observational design of included studies limits the strength and generalizability of the pooled estimates. Therefore, causal inferences cannot be drawn, and further well-designed prospective research is warranted to clarify whether these biomarkers can reliably predict the onset or progression of diabetes. CRD420251275798.

> [!warning] 全文限制
> Springer PDF 下載回應不完整，檔案缺少 PDF EOF marker，未把它當成全文使用。本次評讀依 queue 摘要完成，AMSTAR-2、PRISMA 2020 與納入研究逐篇偏差仍需全文。

> [!info] 品質快照
> 設計：systematic review and meta-analysis，納入 16 篇文章、20 個 individual studies
> 族群：成人 T1DM、T2DM、IFG 或 IGT，與非糖尿病 controls 比較 circulating AOPPs
> GRADE：Very low。摘要層級評分由 deterministic grade_judge 計算，待全文後重算。
> 一句話 verdict：AOPPs 在糖尿病族群較高的關聯訊號一致，但數值差異跨族群變動大，不能據此判定 AOPPs 會造成糖尿病、能預測病程，或可直接作為臨床篩檢工具。

## Summary

> Abstract-level review only。文章摘要支持 association，不支持因果推論。

- T1DM pooled WMD 約 17.5 micromol/L。
- T2DM pooled WMD 約 24.68 micromol/L。
- 研究間 heterogeneity 高，prediction intervals 寬。
- meta-regression 涵蓋 continent、study design、age、sample size、gender、quality、overweight/obesity、hypertension、smoking 與 lipids，但解釋的變異很少。
- T2DM 有 funnel plot asymmetry，trim-and-fill 沒有實質改變估計值。

## 白話導讀

> [!abstract] 整篇講給你聽
> AOPPs 是蛋白質氧化後形成的一類循環生物標記。這篇彙整發現糖尿病患者平均值較高，支持糖尿病與 oxidative stress 同時存在的觀察。研究把 AOPPs 當成關聯指標來討論，還沒有證明它是糖尿病的原因，也沒有證明單獨量 AOPPs 能診斷、預測或改善病人的重要結局。

## Paper Details

### PICO

- Population：成人 T1DM、T2DM、IFG 或 IGT。
- Comparison：非糖尿病 controls。
- Outcome：circulating AOPPs level。
- Design：觀察性研究的 systematic review and meta-analysis。
- Methods from abstract：搜尋 PubMed、Scopus、Embase、Web of Science 至 2025 年 3 月，由兩位 reviewer 獨立擷取資料與品質評估，使用 random-effects model。

### 主要結果

| Diabetes subgroup | Pooled result | Interpretation |
|---|---:|---|
| T1DM | WMD 約 17.5 micromol/L | 平均 AOPPs 較高，但異質性限制外推 |
| T2DM | WMD 約 24.68 micromol/L | 方向一致，大小受族群與研究設計影響 |

Sensitivity analyses 顯示結果方向穩健，但穩健性不能消除 selection bias、measurement heterogeneity 或未測量混雜。

## Critical Appraisal

- **方法學優點**：多資料庫搜尋、雙人獨立擷取、random-effects model、subgroup、meta-regression、sensitivity 與 publication bias 分析都有在摘要交代。
- **主要限制**：摘要沒有呈現搜尋完整性、protocol/registration、納入研究的偏差工具與 individual estimates，也沒有足夠資訊判斷 AOPP assay、樣本處理與控制組定義的一致性。
- **偏差與異質性**：糖尿病亞型、年齡、地區、疾病 duration、併發症、腎功能、藥物與 AOPP assay 都可能造成 variation。高 heterogeneity 與寬 prediction intervals 使單一 pooled WMD 不適合作為個人臨床 cut-off。
- **Publication bias**：T2DM funnel plot asymmetry 是警訊。trim-and-fill 未改變 pooled estimate 可降低部分疑慮，無法證明不存在 selective reporting。
- **推論漏洞**：AOPPs 較高是 association。摘要結論也明確說不能推導 causal inference，且不能直接宣稱可預測 diabetes onset 或 progression。
- **臨床使用**：目前較適合作為研究性 oxidative stress marker，不宜單獨用來診斷糖尿病、調整藥物或取代 HbA1c、血糖與器官併發症評估。

## Grade calculation record

- Starting level：low，因證據體主要是觀察性研究。
- Risk of bias：serious。
- Inconsistency：very serious。
- Indirectness：serious。
- Imprecision：serious。
- Publication bias：serious。
- Deterministic result：Very low。
- 以上評分因全文未取得，待全文後重新檢查。

papers.title: Sarcopenia and body composition abnormalities in chronic pancreatitis: Pathophysiology, assessment, and clinical impact.
papers.authors: Bonsdorff A, Oyon D, Klatte D, Pauw H, Plecic N, Blazevic N, Regner S, Overbeek K
papers.abstract: Chronic pancreatitis is a progressive inflammatory disease associated with substantial nutritional and metabolic consequences. Beyond classical malnutrition, patients frequently develop alterations in body composition, particularly sarcopenia, which are increasingly recognised as clinically relevant but remain inconsistently assessed. The reported prevalence of sarcopenia ranges from 20% to 70%, including a substantial proportion of patients with normal or elevated body mass index. Sarcopenia reflects the combined effects of chronic inflammation, pancreatic exocrine insufficiency, endocrine dysfunction, reduced oral intake, malabsorption, and lifestyle factors such as alcohol use, smoking, and physical inactivity. Advances in imaging and functional assessment allow more precise evaluation of muscle mass, fat distribution, and bone density. Computed tomography-derived skeletal muscle indices, often obtained from routine imaging, provide accurate muscle mass quantification, while handgrip strength and gait speed capture clinically meaningful functional impairment. Observational studies associate sarcopenia with increased healthcare utilisation, higher mortality, and poorer surgical outcomes, although heterogeneity in definitions and study design limits causal inference. Most studies rely on CT-derived muscle mass as the sole diagnostic criterion, consistent with pre-EWGSOP2 frameworks, rather than incorporating muscle strength - typically assessed by grip strength - as now recommended by current consensus groups. Evidence regarding sarcopenic obesity, myosteatosis, and ectopic fat deposition remains limited. Structured nutritional assessment, including the GLIM criteria for malnutrition diagnosis, alongside systematic body composition evaluation and multidisciplinary nutritional and exercise-based interventions, may improve risk stratification and outcomes. Further longitudinal and interventional studies are needed to define disease-specific thresholds and optimise management strategies.

> [!warning] 全文限制
> Clinical Nutrition PDF 受到網站防護，未取得可核對全文。本次評讀依 queue 摘要完成，診斷門檻、研究搜尋與原始研究品質需全文確認。

> [!info] 品質快照
> 設計：narrative review
> 核心問題：chronic pancreatitis 中 sarcopenia、body composition 與臨床結局
> GRADE：n.a.，敘述性回顧沒有單一可直接計算的 evidence body
> 一句話 verdict：文章把 chronic pancreatitis 的營養評估從單純體重拉回肌力、肌肉量與脂肪分布，方向符合臨床需求，但 prevalence、死亡與手術風險多來自異質性觀察研究，不能把關聯直接當成介入效果。

## Summary

> Abstract-level review only。缺少全文時，以下數字與方法細節需回到原文核對。

- sarcopenia prevalence 約 20% 至 70%，即使 BMI 正常或偏高也可能存在。
- 可能成因包括慢性發炎、pancreatic exocrine insufficiency、endocrine dysfunction、攝取不足、malabsorption、酒精、吸菸與缺乏活動。
- CT-derived skeletal muscle index 可利用既有影像量化肌肉量，handgrip strength 與 gait speed 則反映功能。
- 多數研究只用 CT muscle mass，仍沿用 pre-EWGSOP2 思路，沒有納入現在重視的 muscle strength。
- GLIM malnutrition assessment、body composition、營養介入與 exercise-based intervention 可用來改善風險分層，長期介入證據仍不足。

## 白話導讀

> [!abstract] 整篇講給你聽
> 慢性胰臟炎的營養問題不只看體重或 BMI。病人可能外觀看起來不瘦，卻有肌肉量不足、肌力下降、肌肉脂肪化與骨密度問題。臨床上要把既有 CT、握力、步速、飲食吸收、胰外分泌功能與 GLIM 營養診斷放在一起，才比較能看見真正的功能風險。

## Paper Details

### Pathophysiology

- chronic inflammation、pancreatic exocrine insufficiency、endocrine dysfunction、reduced oral intake 與 malabsorption 共同影響 lean mass。
- Alcohol use、smoking、physical inactivity 會再加重身體組成異常。
- sarcopenic obesity、myosteatosis 與 ectopic fat 是重要但資料有限的表型。

### Assessment

- Muscle mass：CT-derived skeletal muscle indices，常可從既有腹部影像取得。
- Muscle strength：handgrip strength。
- Physical performance：gait speed。
- Malnutrition：GLIM criteria。
- 單用 CT muscle mass 可能漏掉肌力下降，也可能因不同 cut-off 與影像層面造成 prevalence 差異。

### Clinical associations

摘要指出 sarcopenia 與較高 healthcare utilisation、mortality 及 poorer surgical outcomes 有關，但這些多是觀察性關聯，可能受到疾病嚴重度、營養吸收、酒精、癌症疑慮、手術選擇與共病混雜。

## Critical Appraisal

- **優點**：把 body composition、muscle strength、GLIM 與多專業營養及運動介入放在同一臨床框架。
- **主要偏差風險**：摘要未交代搜尋策略、研究納入標準、各研究定義與 quality assessment，無法確認引用是否涵蓋相反結果。
- **異質性**：sarcopenia prevalence 20% 至 70% 的範圍很大，可能來自 CT cut-off、族群、疾病期別、BMI、酒精暴露與量測方法不同。
- **時代差異**：多數研究以 CT muscle mass 作為唯一診斷條件，與現在強調 muscle strength 的共識不同，會造成 disease burden 低估或分類不一致。
- **推論漏洞**：與死亡、手術與醫療使用的關聯不等於 sarcopenia 本身造成這些結果。沒有 longitudinal 或 intervention evidence 時，不能直接保證營養與運動介入會降低死亡。
- **實務建議**：把握力、步速、CT body composition、飲食攝取、胰酵素替代與 GLIM 放進同一評估流程，再依個人狀態安排營養與運動方案。
